description: Static scan against WCAG 2.5.1 Pointer Gestures, 2.5.2 Pointer Cancellation, 2.5.3 Label in Name, 2.5.4 Motion Actuation, 2.5.7 Dragging Movements, 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum), 2.1.1 Keyboard and 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus. Pass `source` as HTML, CSS and any script you want covered. It finds :hover reveals with no focus twin, mouseover without focus, title-only names, draggable items and drag libraries, touchmove, swipe and pinch handlers, mousedown or touchstart actions, devicemotion, aria-label that does not contain the visible text, controls declared under 24 CSS px, and click handlers on non-interactive elements. Reads the pasted source only; nothing is rendered or run, stored or logged. Listeners added by bundled libraries are invisible unless named.

source.description: HTML, CSS and script text to scan.
